# smooth paths using natural cubic splines in chord-length parameter
def densify(points, spacing_px=0.9):
    p=np.array(points,float)
    ds=np.r_[0,np.cumsum(np.linalg.norm(np.diff(p,axis=0),axis=1))]
    cs=[CubicSpline(ds,p[:,k],bc_type='natural') for k in range(2)]
    t=np.linspace(0,ds[-1],max(2,int(ds[-1]/spacing_px)+1))
    return np.stack([c(t) for c in cs],axis=1), t

def render(pathlist=paths, presses=presses):
    ink=np.zeros((1024,1024),np.float32)
    for pts, press in zip(pathlist,presses):
        pix,t=densify(pts)
        # convert to world, start at the target centerline point + drag distance, otherwise offset tangent
        X,Y=sheet.mm_to_world(pix[:,0]*px*1000,pix[:,1]*px*1000)
        world=np.stack([X,Y],axis=1)

        # set initial brush root to first point from preceding air movement, and theta along writing tangent
        b.root=tuple(world[0]); b.theta=math.atan2(tang[0,1],tang[0,0])
        # sample every ~.2mm; pressure fixed. Footprints filled each physics sample.
        prev=None
        for k in range(len(world)):
            x,y=world[k]
            b.step(x,y,press)
            th=b.theta or 0.
            fp=(b.root[0],b.root[1],th,b.w,b.d)
            if prev is None: fps=[fp]
            else:
                dth=(fp[2]-prev[2]+math.pi)%(2*math.pi)-math.pi

    return ink
